SEC grants 5-year "innovation exemption" for tokenized securities venues –
Link
The SEC approved a temporary, conditional exemption letting on-chain platforms list and trade tokenized US stocks with full shareholder rights, without being immediately classified as exchanges under the 1934 Act.
This is a real unlock for tokenized equities on-chain, and it could benefit Solana-based venues and DEX infrastructure providers as institutional adoption picks up.

Fed raises rates 25bps to 3.75%–4% –
Link
The Fed unanimously approved a 25bp rate hike on September 17 — its first increase since 2023. BTC briefly dropped to $75,700 before rebounding to $76,400. CME FedWatch now puts the odds of a cumulative 25bp hike by December at 49.6%, with 37.2% odds on 50bp.
The market absorbed this hike well, but tightening ahead could still squeeze crypto liquidity. October and December are the next catalysts to watch.
